_comment: CAPACITIES reference (ROADMAP P3.0, gap G-M) — every known authoring ceiling with its evidence. Hand-compiled S91; no generator by design (measured entries cite their S91 emulator experiment; documented entries cite the owning doc/session and were compiled, not re-derived, this session). The editor's capacity meters (EDITOR_DESIGN §5.C) read this file. status values: measured_s91 = empirically measured in PyBoy this session; structural_s91 = derived from disassembly/ROM bytes this session; documented = compiled from the owning doc.

npc_slots_per_screen_state.detail: Hard ceiling 8 NPC entries per (screen, step-state) interact block. RoomEntry7_RoomInit ($0B:$470F) zero-fills exactly $101 bytes at $D7D2 (8 x 32-byte slots + terminator cell $D8D2; FillNBytesWithRegA BC is a plain 16-bit count); the parser (Call_00b_477e) has NO bounds check. Vanilla respects it: valid-step census over all rooms maxes at exactly 8. MEASURED overflow: with 8 entries the terminator lands exactly at $D8D2 (safe); a 9th entry writes into the NPC-script state block — vs an 8-NPC control, corrupts $D8D9 (queued text id) and $D8E2/$D8E3/$D8E6/$D8E7/$D8E8 — silently, no crash. The editor must hard-cap at 8.
npc_slots_per_screen_state.evidence: disassembly/bank_00b.asm RoomEntry7_RoomInit + Call_00b_477e; ROOM_DATA_FORMAT 'NPC capacity & sprite-sheet budget (S91)'

npc_distinct_sprite_sheets_per_screen.detail: NPC sprite sheets load into a shared per-screen VRAM tile budget at room init, first-come in entry order; when the budget is exhausted, later distinct ids render BLANK (no crash, no wedge). Measured: 8 distinct human sheets ($00-$0F range) all render; a batch of 8 distinct boss_composite_fragment ids rendered 2 full + 1 partial + 5 blank. Repeats of the same id are free (share the sheet). Editor meter: warn when adding distinct sprite ids beyond what renders; exact tile counts per sheet are unmeasured (residual).
npc_distinct_sprite_sheets_per_screen.evidence: S91 PyBoy batches (throne room); ROOM_DATA_FORMAT 'NPC capacity & sprite-sheet budget (S91)'

screens_per_room.detail: Engine scroll math caps at a 4x4 grid = 16 screens (RoomEntry2: row = Y/128 clamped 0-3, col = X/160 clamped 0-3). Vanilla's largest grids are the conveyor/maze rooms mt $54-$59: 12 declared screen slots, 9 with valid steps; screen_index 8 (row 2) render + scroll VERIFIED in PyBoy (warp mt $54 abs (4,18) -> wScreenIndex 8, field renders). The CUSTOM pipeline currently accepts only 4x2 = 8 (project.json screens keys '0'..'7', PROJECT_COMPILER §room schema); extending the schema to 4x4 is a named residual, not an engine limit. Room dims in the $26DD record must match the screen count (KEY_LESSONS S10 hazard).
screens_per_room.evidence: disassembly/bank_00b.asm RoomEntry2_ScreenScroll; ROOM_DATA_FORMAT 'Scroll Boundary System'; S91 PyBoy warp; PROJECT_COMPILER
